frase_clave: Instruct employers, managers, and supervisors on fundamental concepts and techniques for recognizing hazards and methods of controlling them, including the hierarchy of controls
razon: Literal.

frase_clave: Share results with workers and invite their input on how to further improve performance.
razon: El libro pide recoger, analizar y compartir datos de desempeno.

libro: Managing the Risks of Organizat - Reason, J. T_
frase_clave: Starting with the end result, a loss of some kind, the analyst works backwards
razon: El libro fija la pérdida como punto de partida del análisis Tripod-Beta, y los targets como lo que sufre el daño.

libro: Managing the Risks of Organizat - Reason, J. T_
frase_clave: The management needs to keep the workforce informed of remedial progress at all times. If nothing is seen to be done, there is no incentive to give assessments and the system dies.
razon: Parafrasis directa.

frase_clave: Use checklists that highlight things to look for. Typical hazards fall into several major categories
razon: Electrico, incendio y ergonomia figuran entre las categorias.

frase_clave: Input from workers, including surveys or minutes from safety and health committee meetings.
razon: Encuestas (L485) y hablar con los trabajadores (L505) estan en el libro.

frase_clave: Develop a clear plan and procedure for conducting incident investigations, so that an investigation can begin immediately when an incident occurs.
razon: El plan incluye quien participa, es decir las responsabilidades.

libro: Managing the Risks of Organizat - Reason, J. T_
frase_clave: The frequency with which these checks are carried out will depend upon the rate at which the process in question is likely to change. Workplace factors change more rapidly than organizational ones
razon: Literal.

libro: Managing the Risks of Organizat - Reason, J. T_
frase_clave: Local and organizational conditions Analysis of many incidents can reveal recurrent patterns of cause and effect.
razon: El libro dice que analizar muchos incidentes revela patrones recurrentes de causa y efecto en las condiciones locales y organizacionales.

libro: Managing the Risks of Organizat - Reason, J. T_
frase_clave: a bad organizational accident can achieve some dramatic conversions to the 'safety faith', but these are all too often shortlived.
razon: Parafrasis directa.

frase_clave: identify any exposures to excessive noise (areas where you must raise your voice to be heard by others), elevated heat (indoor and outdoor), or sources of radiation
razon: Parafrasis directa.

frase_clave: Communicate the policy to all workers and, at appropriate times and places, to relevant parties
razon: Contratistas, proveedores y visitantes figuran en la lista.

frase_clave: examine work activities that require heavy lifting, work above shoulder height, repetitive motions, or tasks with significant vibration.
razon: Parafrasis directa.

libro: Managing the Risks of Organizat - Reason, J. T_
frase_clave: They are best addressed by changing people's norms, beliefs, attitudes and culture, on the one hand, and by improving the credibility, applicability, availability and accuracy of the procedures, on the other.
razon: El libro pide actuar sobre normas y actitudes ademas de los procedimientos.

libro: Managing the Risks of Organizat - Reason, J. T_
frase_clave: the analyst works backwards to determine the nature of the failed defence(s) and the hazard.
razon: Es una paráfrasis directa del libro.

frase_clave: Material on elevated surfaces is piled, stacked, or racked in a manner to prevent it from tipping, falling, collapsing, rolling, or spreading.
razon: El libro pide apilar o colocar el material en altura para que no vuelque ni caiga, y aparte pide espacio libre adecuado (appropriate headroom). El paso junta ambas cosas y concreta la accion sin datos nuevos.

frase_clave: Have all control measures been implemented according to the hazard control plan?
razon: Parafrasis directa de la primera pregunta de seguimiento del libro.

frase_clave: Fire extinguishers are visually inspected monthly, and the inspection is recorded.
razon: Literal: inspección visual mensual y registro.

frase_clave: Harmonize their safety and health policies and procedures to resolve important differences, so that all workers at the site have the same protection
razon: El libro pide resolver conflictos antes de empezar (L227, L1047) y pone como ejemplo las políticas inconsistentes de EPP (L995).

frase_clave: Some hazards, such as housekeeping and tripping hazards, can and should be fixed as they are found.
razon: Literal: corregir en el momento peligros evidentes como los tropiezos.

frase_clave: Protection from retaliation means that an employer cannot retaliate by taking "adverse action" against workers, such as: ... Disciplining
razon: El libro prohibe las represalias, incluida la sancion disciplinaria, contra quien ejerce sus derechos, y en el mismo apartado describe el derecho a negarse a trabajar. El paso lo aplica a ese derecho en concreto, en la misma direccion.

frase_clave: The OSHA On-Site Consultation Program offers no-cost and confidential occupational safety and health services to small and medium- businesses
razon: El libro recomienda el programa gratuito de consultoria de OSHA. El paso lo generaliza a un servicio equivalente en el pais del lector, sin datos nuevos.

frase_clave: The hazard communication program is reviewed periodically to ensure it is meeting its objectives, and is revised/ updated as appropriate
razon: Literal: revisar y actualizar el programa periódicamente.

frase_clave: Standard stairs are at least 22 inches (56 centimeters) wide.
razon: El libro fija un ancho minimo (22 pulgadas, 56 cm segun la norma de EE. UU.). El paso manda a consultar el minimo de la norma local. No da otra cifra ni contradice: localiza el dato en la misma direccion.

frase_clave: By initially focusing on achieving modest goals, monitoring performance, and evaluating outcomes
razon: Literal: empezar con metas modestas.

frase_clave: For each hazard identified, determine the severity and likelihood of incidents that could result, and use this information to prioritize corrective actions.
razon: Parafrasis directa.

frase_clave: Review sources such as OSHA standards and guidance, industry consensus standards, NIOSH publications, manufacturers' literature, and engineering reports to identify potential control measures.
razon: Paráfrasis: estándares, literatura de fabricantes y medidas usadas en otros lugares (L657).

frase_clave: Evaluate each hazard by considering the severity of potential outcomes, the likelihood that an event or exposure will occur
razon: Literal.

frase_clave: An effective way to identify workplace hazards is for knowledgeable and experienced workers to conduct routine safety and health inspections
razon: Paráfrasis: inspecciones rutinarias con personas con experiencia.

frase_clave: Provide opportunities for workers to participate in all aspects of the program
razon: El libro enumera metas, análisis de peligros, inspecciones, formación y desarrollo de soluciones.

frase_clave: The checklists are based on several sources, including OSHA standards and generally accepted safety and health principles.
razon: El libro propone checklists basados en normas y principios reconocidos y pide reunir la informacion de los checklists completados. Documentar los hallazgos con ellos concreta eso sin datos nuevos.

frase_clave: Train workers on how to identify and control hazards using, for example, OSHA's Hazard Identification Training Tool.
razon: Tiene razon el LECTOR B. El libro dice dos veces lo mismo que el paso: en la lista de nueve pasos (L121-L124) pide formar a los trabajadores para identificar y controlar peligros apoyandose, por ejemplo, en la herramienta de OSHA para identificar peligros, y en el Action item 4 (L871-L881) pide formar en el reconocimiento de peligros e instruir sobre la jerarquia de controles y su importancia (L881). El paso es una parafrasis de ese texto. La unica diferencia, 'herramientas de identificacion de peligros disponibles en tu pais', solo localiza la herramienta que el libro ya nombra como ejemplo, sin anadir accion, objeto ni condicion, y tampoco la concreta mas que el libro. No hay nada que ponga el paso en OPERATIVO: no concreta nada que el libro deje abierto.

frase_clave: Plans and procedures need to be developed for responding appropriately and safely to hazards associated with foreseeable emergency scenarios and nonroutine situations.
razon: Paráfrasis directa.

frase_clave: LEAD BY EXAMPLE Practice safe behaviors yourself and make safety part of your daily conversations with workers.
razon: Parafrasis directa del paso 2.

frase_clave: A process is in place to periodically evaluate the steps taken to identify and control ergonomic risk factors
razon: Paráfrasis: evaluar periódicamente si las medidas funcionan.

frase_clave: Broken or fractured handles on hammers, axes, and similar equipment are replaced.
razon: El libro pide reemplazar los mangos rotos y reacondicionar o reemplazar las cabezas deformadas (L687).

frase_clave: Procure any equipment needed to control emergency-related hazards.
razon: Literal.

frase_clave: Develop procedures to control hazards that may arise during nonroutine tasks
razon: Literal.

frase_clave: employers should track progress in implementing controls, inspect and evaluate controls once they are installed
razon: El libro pide dar seguimiento a la implantacion de los controles. Documentar y dar seguimiento a las correcciones concreta eso sin datos nuevos.

frase_clave: provisions are made to ensure that no one is below hoisted material or equipment.
razon: Paráfrasis directa.

frase_clave: Workers working on surfaces that are elevated more than 4 feet (1. 2 meters) above a lower level are protected from falling
razon: El libro aplica la proteccion a las superficies de mas de 4 pies. Localizarlas es el paso previo en la misma direccion, con el mismo umbral.

frase_clave: Host employers, contractors, and staffing agencies commmunicate the hazards present at the worksite
razon: El libro incluye la comunicacion y coordinacion con contratistas y agencias de personal temporal como parte del programa.

frase_clave: Plan how you will track progress toward completion.
razon: Literal.

frase_clave: Identify foreseeable emergency scenarios and develop instructions on what to do in each case. Meet to discuss these procedures and post them in a visible location at the job site.
razon: Une los pasos 7 y 8 del libro: aplicar controles e instrucciones de emergencia colocadas a la vista. El libro pide encargar a los trabajadores que elijan, apliquen y evaluen las soluciones; el paso no lo menciona, pero no lo contradice.

frase_clave: All ladders are routinely inspected for damage.
razon: Literal.

frase_clave: and, where possible, a worker has brought the condition to the attention of the employer.
razon: El libro pone como condicion que el trabajador avise antes al empleador cuando sea posible. Crear un canal para ese aviso concreta eso sin datos nuevos.

frase_clave: Portable metal ladders are legibly marked with signs reading "CAUTION - Do Not Use Around Electrical Equipment" or equivalent wording.
razon: Literal.

frase_clave: If controls are not effective, identify, select, and implement further control measures that will provide adequate protection.
razon: Literal.

frase_clave: should make adjustments and monitor how well the program performs as a result.
razon: Paráfrasis del elemento de evaluación y mejora del programa.

frase_clave: Stairway handrails are capable of withstanding a load of 200 pounds (890 Newtons)
razon: El libro da la carga (200 libras, 890 N segun la norma de EE. UU.). El paso remite a la carga minima de la norma local sin dar otra cifra: localiza el dato en la misma direccion.

frase_clave: Workers, supervisors, and managers are trained on the signs and symptoms of MSDs
razon: Parafrasis directa.

frase_clave: Ladders with structural or other defects are immediately tagged "Dangerous: Do Not Use" or with similar language and removed from service
razon: Literal.

frase_clave: Ensure that training is provided in the language(s) and at a literacy level that all workers can understand.
razon: Literal. El L417 cubre a los compañeros actuales y a los recién llegados.

frase_clave: A qualified health care provider in work- MSDs has reviewed the medical protocols to manage reports and treatment of MSD signs and symptoms.
razon: Paráfrasis directa.

frase_clave: Prioritize the hazards so that those presenting the greatest risk are addressed first.
razon: Literal.

frase_clave: Assign responsibilities for implementing the emergency plan.
razon: Literal.

frase_clave: Workers exposed to potential falling objects wear appropriate PPE, such as head protection.
razon: Parafrasis directa.

frase_clave: Approved containers and tanks are used to store and handle flammable and combustible liquids.
razon: Literal.

frase_clave: You might want to start by selecting the checklists that apply to areas that are most critical to your business
razon: Literal.

frase_clave: Canopy structures are erected under elevated surfaces
razon: Literal (el libro admite además la alternativa de acordonar la zona).

frase_clave: Toeboards, screens, or guardrail systems are erected to prevent objects from falling to lower levels.
razon: Literal.

frase_clave: A recognized hazard is a danger recognized by the employer's industry or industry in general, by the employer, or by common sense.
razon: Paráfrasis directa.

frase_clave: Workers are trained on the hazardous chemicals in their work area before initial assignment, and when new hazards are introduced.
razon: Parafrasis directa.

frase_clave: Develop and communicate a simple procedure for workers to report any injuries, illnesses, incidents including near misses/close calls), hazards, or safety and health concerns without fear of retaliation.
razon: Paráfrasis directa.

frase_clave: the workers are provided with initial training in their use and at least annually thereafter.
razon: Coincide con la frecuencia anual del libro.

frase_clave: Set aside a regular time to discuss safety and health issues, with the goal of identifying ways to improve the program.
razon: El tiempo regular está en L147 y la consulta a los trabajadores antes de cambios en L547 ('seek the input of workers').

frase_clave: employers have an ongoing obligation to control all serious recognized hazards and to protect workers.
razon: Paráfrasis directa.

frase_clave: Fire extinguishers are selected and provided for the types of materials in the areas where they are to be used.
razon: El libro elige el extintor segun el tipo de material (clases A, B, C, D, K). Clasificar los materiales del area concreta ese criterio.

frase_clave: Steps have been taken to reduce the risk of MSDs by implementing engineering controls
razon: Paráfrasis de los controles de ingeniería, administrativos y de EPP.

frase_clave: Rotating or moving parts of equipment are guarded to prevent physical contact.
razon: Literal.

frase_clave: Where flammable liquids are transferred and dispensed, appropriate grounding and bonding methods are used
razon: Literal.

frase_clave: ALWAYS SET SAFETY AND HEALTH AS THE TOP PRIORITY
razon: Literal.

frase_clave: Include in contracts and bid documents any safety-related specifications and pre-qualifications
razon: Literal (también L225).

frase_clave: Compile information from your completed checklists with workplace injury and illness records, worker training information, and process and equipment information
razon: Literal.

frase_clave: "EXPLOSIVE- TOOL IN USE" is conspicuously posted when the tool is being used.
razon: Literal.

frase_clave: A worksite analysis has been performed to identify ergonomics-related hazards with input from workers.
razon: El recorrido concreta el analisis del lugar de trabajo con aportes de los trabajadores que pide el libro.

frase_clave: Report back to workers routinely and frequently about action taken in response to their concerns and suggestions.
razon: Parafrasis directa.

frase_clave: Procedures are put in place to continually identify workplace hazards and evaluate risks.
razon: Paráfrasis de los elementos de identificación y control.

frase_clave: Safety Data Sheets (SDS) for each hazardous chemical in the workplace are up-to-date and readily accessible to workers.
razon: Literal.

frase_clave: Instruct workers on how to report injuries, illnesses, incidents, and concerns.
razon: Literal (también L819).

frase_clave: Prior to initiating such work, review JSAs/JHAs with any workers involved
razon: Literal.

frase_clave: Ensure that workers from all levels of the organization can participate regardless of their skill level, education, or language.
razon: Paráfrasis de la acción 5 (quitar barreras).

frase_clave: Each explosive-actuated tool is stored in its own locked container when not being used.
razon: Parafrasis directa.

frase_clave: List the hazards needing controls in order of priority.
razon: Literal.

frase_clave: Refer to National Fire Protection Association standard #10 (NFPA 10) for guidance on types, numbers, and locations.
razon: El libro pide extintores en lugares de fácil acceso y remite a NFPA 10.

frase_clave: The load is well secured and properly balanced before it is lifted more than a few inches.
razon: Paráfrasis; el paso es algo más estricto y no contradice.

frase_clave: to determine which among them will implement and maintain the various parts of the safety and health program, to ensure protection of all on-site workers before work begins.
razon: Paráfrasis de L1021 y L1051 (planificación y cronograma).

frase_clave: Give workers the information they need to understand safety and health hazards and control measures in the workplace.
razon: El libro enumera las SDS, los datos de lesiones y los informes de inspección.

frase_clave: You can use the self-evaluation tool found on the recommended practices Web page to track your progress and assess how fully you have implemented (or will implement) each action item.
razon: El libro propone autoevaluar el programa y reunir la informacion existente sobre peligros. Diagnosticar el estado actual concreta eso sin datos nuevos.

frase_clave: Post the 11(c) fact sheet ... Incentive programs (such as point systems, awards, and prizes) should be designed in a manner that does not discourage injury and illness reporting
razon: El libro pide dar a conocer la proteccion contra represalias (hoja 11(c)) y cuidar que los incentivos no desalienten los reportes. El paso lo localiza al pais, en la misma direccion.

frase_clave: are protected from falling by guardrail systems, safety net systems, or personal fall protection systems.
razon: Parafrasis directa.

frase_clave: Develop or modify plans to control hazards that may arise in emergency situations.
razon: Literal.

frase_clave: Each worker who operates an explosive- tool is trained in its use and has a valid operator's card.
razon: Literal.

frase_clave: shall furnish to each of his employees employment and a place of employment which are free from recognized hazards that are causing or are likely to cause death or serious physical harm
razon: La clausula de deber general obliga a controlar los peligros reconocidos aunque no haya norma especifica. El paso lo lleva a la accion en la misma direccion, aunque omite que se trata de peligros reconocidos y graves.

frase_clave: Have workers been appropriately trained so that they understand the controls, including how to operate engineering controls, safe work practices, and PPE use requirements?
razon: El libro pregunta si los trabajadores fueron capacitados en los controles. El paso habla de ti (fuiste capacitado), no de los trabajadores; va en la misma direccion, pero conviene que diga que se verifique la capacitacion de los trabajadores.

frase_clave: "NO SMOKING" signs are in areas where flammable or combustible materials are used and stored.
razon: Literal (L621 añade los tanques de GLP).

frase_clave: Existing problems have been identified by reviewing OSHA 300 logs, workers' compensation records, first aid logs, accident and near-miss investigation reports, insurance company reports, or employee reports of symptoms.
razon: Tiene razon el LECTOR B. En la lista de ergonomia, el libro pide identificar los problemas existentes revisando el registro de lesiones OSHA 300, los registros de indemnizacion laboral, los de primeros auxilios y los informes de accidentes y casi accidentes (L385). El paso dice justo eso: registros de accidentes, incapacidades y primeros auxilios, con el mismo fin de identificar problemas existentes. Es una parafrasis que toma una parte de la lista del libro. El parentesis 'consulta que registros exige tu mercado' solo localiza el OSHA 300, un registro obligatorio de EE. UU. que el propio libro trata como exigencia legal (L257). No anade otro dato ni concreta nada mas alla del libro, asi que no llega a OPERATIVO.

frase_clave: Information is communicated before on-site work starts and, as needed, if conditions change.
razon: El libro incluye los peligros no rutinarios y de emergencia (L1033).

frase_clave: Assign responsibility for installing/ implementing the controls to a specific person or persons with the power or ability to implement the controls.
razon: Literal.

frase_clave: Select controls according to a hierarchy that emphasizes engineering solutions (including elimination or substitution) first, followed by safe work practices, administrative controls, and finally PPE.
razon: Recoge el orden de la jerarquia NIOSH que da el libro.

frase_clave: All ropes are thoroughly inspected at least once a month and a certification record which includes the inspection date, inspector signature, and an identifier for inspected ropes, is kept on file.
razon: Coinciden la inspección mensual y el registro de certificación; el libro añade para ganchos y cadenas una revisión visual diaria que el paso no menciona pero no contradice.

frase_clave: Explosive-actuated tools are inspected for obstructions or defects before use.
razon: Literal.

frase_clave: Plan how you will verify the effectiveness of controls after they are installed or implemented.
razon: Literal.

frase_clave: Have engineering controls been properly installed and tested?
razon: Literal.

frase_clave: the number of workers who might be exposed.
razon: Literal.

frase_clave: Cord-connected, electrically operated tools and equipment are effectively grounded or of the approved double insulated type.
razon: Parafrasis directa.

frase_clave: A list or inventory of all hazardous chemicals in the workplace has been prepared
razon: Literal.

frase_clave: select equipment, machinery, and materials that are inherently safer based on the application of "Prevention through Design" (PtD) principles.
razon: Literal.

frase_clave: The general duty clause does not apply if there is an OSHA standard dealing with the hazard
razon: La clausula general cubre los peligros que ninguna norma trata. Identificarlos es el paso previo en la misma direccion.

frase_clave: Use a combination of control options when no single method fully protects workers.
razon: Literal; evitar nuevos peligros está en L675.

frase_clave: Tools are stored in a dry, secure location where tampering is not possible.
razon: Literal.

frase_clave: Overhead and gantry cranes are periodically inspected for defects or safety concerns in 1 to 12 month intervals depending on equipment activity, severity of service, and environment.
razon: Paráfrasis; omite el intervalo pero no lo cambia.

frase_clave: A critical element of any effective safety and health program is a proactive, ongoing process to identify and assess such hazards.
razon: Parafrasis directa.

frase_clave: Include an option for anonymous reporting to reduce fear of reprisal.
razon: Literal (el procedimiento sencillo está en L93).

frase_clave: General contractors, contractors, and staffing agencies commit to providing the same level of safety and health protection to all employees.
razon: Literal.

frase_clave: Conduct routine preventive maintenance of equipment, facilities, and controls
razon: Literal.

frase_clave: Reinforce employers, managers, and supervisors' knowledge of their responsibilities under the OSH Act and the workers' rights guaranteed by the Act.
razon: El libro incluye el liderazgo (L801), la investigación de incidentes (L847) y la respuesta a reportes sin desalentarlos (L843).

frase_clave: Train workers on techniques for identifying hazards
razon: Paráfrasis; la formación del empleador está en L839.

frase_clave: Evaluate control measures to determine if they are effective or need to be modified.
razon: Parafrasis directa.

frase_clave: Safety and health policies, goals, and procedures
razon: Paráfrasis de la formación sobre el programa.

frase_clave: the ladder always extends at least 3 feet (0. 9 meters) above the elevated surface.
razon: Literal; los 3 pies coinciden.

frase_clave: The rated load of each hoist is legibly marked and visible to the operator.
razon: Literal; el interruptor de límite está en L1105.

frase_clave: Inside storage rooms for flammable and combustible liquids have mechanical or gravity ventilation.
razon: Literal.

frase_clave: Use interim control measures to protect workers until more permanent solutions can be implemented.
razon: Literal (también L677).

frase_clave: Stair rail systems and handrails are provided on all stairways having at least four risers.
razon: Parafrasis directa con el mismo umbral de cuatro escalones.

frase_clave: A plan is developed to ensure that controls are implemented, interim protection is provided, progress is tracked
razon: El plan con fechas objetivo (L723) y protección provisional (L189, L685) está en el libro.

frase_clave: Establish a target completion date.
razon: Literal.

frase_clave: Stair riser heights and tread depths are uniform between landings.
razon: Literal; 'Steps are slip-resistant' está en L1543.

frase_clave: PPE is maintained in a sanitary condition and ready for use.
razon: El libro pide mantener el EPP en condicion sanitaria y listo para usar; el paso lo parafrasea sin anadir nada.

frase_clave: Fully supplied first aid kits are easily accessible to each work area, are adequate for the particular area or operation, and are periodically inspected and replenished as needed.
razon: Botiquines completos, accesibles e inspeccionados periodicamente, igual que el libro.

frase_clave: Eye-wash fountains and safety showers are provided and maintained in areas where hazardous chemicals are handled.
razon: Paso literal del libro.

frase_clave: If you are in a state with an OSHA-approved State Plan, you may be subject to different or additional requirements
razon: El libro explica que en un estado con Plan Estatal puedes tener otros requisitos y remite a la pagina de Planes Estatales y al mapa (tambien L9: la lista esta en la web de OSHA). Revisar si tu estado tiene plan concreta eso, sin datos nuevos.

frase_clave: a method for accounting for all workers. ... The plan addresses how visitors will be assisted in evacuation and accounted for.
razon: El libro pide un metodo de conteo de trabajadores y de visitantes tras la evacuacion.

frase_clave: A worksite analysis has identified workplace violence-related hazards.
razon: Analisis del lugar de trabajo para riesgos de violencia; el paso lo parafrasea.

frase_clave: The OSHA Training Institute partners with OSHA Training Institute Education Centers at locations throughout the United States to deliver courses on OSHA standards
razon: El libro describe los Centros de Educacion y sus cursos; identificar los cursos relevantes es la accion natural derivada, sin datos nuevos. (El libro aclara que hay matricula para el sector privado; el paso no afirma lo contrario.)

frase_clave: Material and equipment is stored in such a way that projections do not interfere with walkways.
razon: Guardar material sin bloquear pasillos, como el libro.

frase_clave: You must electronically submit information from your Form 300A Summary to OSHA annually ... if: You have an establishment with 250 or more workers
razon: El libro obliga a enviar electronicamente la informacion de los formularios segun el tamano del establecimiento y el sector de alto riesgo; el paso lo parafrasea con la misma condicion (tamano y sector) y sin cifras nuevas.

frase_clave: Review the OSHA standards to identify those that apply to your business.
razon: Revisar las normas aplicables, parafraseado.

frase_clave: Through this program, authorized trainers provide 10- and 30-hour training programs.
razon: El libro presenta el programa Outreach de 10 y 30 horas como voluntario para formar a los trabajadores (y en L1767 recomienda la de 10 horas a jovenes); organizarla para tu equipo concreta eso en la misma direccion.

frase_clave: An acclimatization plan is in place to modify work duties for and to closely supervise (1) new workers, (2) temporary or contract workers, and (3) workers returning from extended leave
razon: Plan de aclimatacion para nuevos y quienes regresan de licencia, como el libro.

frase_clave: Loads handled do not exceed the rated capacity of the PIT.
razon: Paso literal del libro.

frase_clave: Workers are trained on safe methods of machine operation.
razon: Paso literal del libro.

frase_clave: Respirators are National Institute for Occupational Safety and Health (NIOSH)- approved for the particular application.
razon: Paso literal del libro.

frase_clave: Bench and pedestal grinders are permanently mounted.
razon: Traduccion literal del punto de la lista de verificacion.

frase_clave: The plan outlines specific evacuation routes and exits ... The plan identifies one or more assembly areas
razon: Rutas de evacuacion y puntos de encuentro en el plan, como el libro.

frase_clave: The plan address procedures for assisting people during evacuations, particularly those with disabilities or who do not speak English.
razon: El paso adapta 'English' a idioma local, sin cambiar el sentido.

frase_clave: Spilled materials are cleaned up immediately.
razon: Paso literal del libro.

frase_clave: Provide personal protective equipment (e. g. , gloves, eye protection, masks or NIOSH Approved® respirators) when necessary
razon: Mismo EPP y misma condicion de necesidad.

frase_clave: PPE is provided by the employer, at no cost to the workers, except as noted in 29 CFR 1910.132(h).
razon: EPP sin costo salvo excepciones normativas, como el libro.

frase_clave: Ensure infectious waste is placed in closable, leak-proof containers, bags, or puncture- containers with proper labels. / Dispose of contaminated sharps in puncture- containers that are properly identified and labeled.
razon: Tiene razon el LECTOR B. El libro trata residuos infecciosos (L909: recipientes cerrables, a prueba de fugas, bolsas o recipientes resistentes a perforacion, etiquetados) y punzocortantes (L911: recipientes resistentes a perforacion, identificados y etiquetados) en dos puntos distintos. El paso los une y les aplica a ambos 'cerrados y a prueba de fugas', y lo concreta como 'consigue'. No es FIEL literal porque para los punzocortantes el libro pide resistencia a perforacion, no a fugas; pero no invierte nada ni aporta dato nuevo, va en la misma direccion. No hay en el resto del libro otro pasaje sobre punzocortantes (Grep: solo L909 y L911).

frase_clave: To participate, employers must submit an application to OSHA and undergo a rigorous onsite evaluation
razon: Solicitud y evaluacion en sitio, como el libro.

frase_clave: The plan identifies a clear chain of command and designates a person authorized to order an evacuation or shutdown of operations.
razon: Cadena de mando y persona autorizada a ordenar evacuacion.

frase_clave: Workers have been trained on PPE procedures, including what PPE is necessary for job tasks, when it is needed, and how to properly wear and adjust it.
razon: Capacitar en cuando y como usar el EPP.

frase_clave: The plan considers the impact of these internal and external emergencies on workplace operations
razon: Identificar emergencias internas y externas.

frase_clave: Outreach training does not fulfill the training requirements found in OSHA standards. Employers must provide additional training for their workers on specific hazards of their job.
razon: Complementar Outreach con la capacitacion especifica que exigen las normas.

frase_clave: professional associations that have a broad range of expertise and information on workplace safety and health and have local chapters that small businesses could join
razon: Tiene razon el LECTOR B. El libro presenta las asociaciones profesionales (National Safety Council, ASSP, AIHA) como fuente de experiencia a la que el pequeno negocio puede sumarse; no dice literalmente 'buscar y consultar' ni 'relevantes para tu sector'. El paso convierte esa descripcion en una accion concreta en la misma direccion, sin cifra, plazo ni responsable nuevo. Encaja con la linea L1963 sobre asociaciones gremiales ('find out how it is assisting its members'). Es concrecion, no parafrasis del libro.

frase_clave: including, e. g. , hand hygiene, cleaning and disinfection
razon: Higiene de manos, limpieza y desinfeccion de superficies.

frase_clave: A supplementary record of each recordable occupational injury and illness is prepared for recordable cases on OSHA Form 301
razon: Reporte por cada caso registrable.

frase_clave: recognize employers and workers ... who have implemented effective safety and health management systems and maintain injury and illness rates below national Bureau of Labor Statistics averages
razon: El libro da los criterios de VPP y el proceso de solicitud; revisar si cumples esos criterios es la concrecion directa.

frase_clave: The Small Business Resource Guide provides plans, tools, tips, and information for keeping your workers safe
razon: Recurso citado por el libro.

frase_clave: Walking-working surfaces are inspected regularly and maintained in a safe condition.
razon: Revisar con regularidad las zonas de paso.

frase_clave: cleaning, disinfecting, storing, inspecting, repairing, discarding, and otherwise maintaining respirators
razon: Procedimientos de almacenamiento, limpieza e inspeccion regular, como el libro.

frase_clave: Medical or biological monitoring systems are in operation for eligible workers (e. g. , exposure to cadmium, lead).
razon: El paso dice lo mismo: monitoreo medico o biologico para trabajadores expuestos a sustancias concretas.

frase_clave: Noise levels have been measured with a sound level meter or an octave band analyzer
razon: Paso literal del libro.

frase_clave: Workplace violence incidents are identified in safety and health records, including the OSHA 300 log, first aid records, near miss reports
razon: Revisar registros de incidentes, primeros auxilios y casi accidentes.

frase_clave: For equipment or lines that cannot be shut down, or locked out and tagged, a safe job procedure is established and rigidly followed.
razon: Procedimiento alterno seguro, como el libro.

frase_clave: A written program is in place to prevent workplace violence. The program is reviewed annually and updated as necessary.
razon: Programa escrito revisado cada ano, literal.

frase_clave: Workers are properly trained, and certified by the employer ... and only trained workers operate the PIT.
razon: Capacitar y certificar antes de operar.

frase_clave: Trucks and trailers are secured from movement during loading and unloading operations.
razon: Parafrasis directa del punto del libro.

frase_clave: PITs are inspected at the beginning of each work shift for any safety concerns. PITs in need of repair are removed from service immediately.
razon: Inspeccion al inicio de turno y retiro de servicio, literal.

frase_clave: Conduct a hazard assessment to identify job tasks in which workers have potential occupational exposure to infectious agents.
razon: Evaluar riesgos de exposicion a agentes infecciosos.

frase_clave: Engineering controls (e. g. , access to exits, physical barriers, and security technology, such as panic buttons/alarm systems) and administrative controls
razon: Alarmas, barreras, protocolos y sistema de acompanamiento estan en el libro.

frase_clave: New abrasive wheels are visually inspected and ring tested before they are mounted.
razon: Paso literal del libro.

frase_clave: visit the OSHA website or contact the nearest OSHA Area Office or your state On-Site Consultation program
razon: Mismas tres vias de consulta, adaptadas al mercado.

frase_clave: Aisles are permanently marked and kept clear to allow unhindered passage.
razon: El libro pide pasillos marcados y despejados y espacio seguro para el equipo de manejo de materiales; el paso lo resume sin anadir.

frase_clave: administers the Small Business Development Center (SBDC) Program to provide management and technical assistance to current and prospective small business owners
razon: El libro presenta los centros de desarrollo de pequenos negocios como fuente de asistencia tecnica; acudir al de tu zona a pedirla concreta eso sin datos nuevos.

frase_clave: Workers in high noise areas are given periodic audiometric testing
razon: Pruebas audiometricas periodicas, literal.

frase_clave: An annual summary is prepared at the end of each calendar year using OSHA Form 300A
razon: Resumen anual y su publicacion en el periodo que fija la norma (el libro da febrero a abril); el paso no cambia el dato.

frase_clave: A designated, trained individual at the worksite is responsible for (1) assessing and monitoring conditions
razon: Responsable designado y capacitado, como el libro.

frase_clave: The NIOSH HHE Program helps employers and employees learn whether health hazards are present at their workplace ... Evaluations are done at no cost.
razon: HHE gratuita para saber si hay peligros de salud.

frase_clave: Employers are partially exempt from OSHA's injury and illness recordkeeping requirements if 1) they had 10 or fewer workers ... or 2) they are in certain low-hazard industries
razon: Exencion segun tamano y actividad.

frase_clave: Workers are properly fitted and instructed in the use of hearing protectors.
razon: El libro pide proteccion auditiva aprobada disponible y ajustarla e instruir en su uso; el paso lo parafrasea.

frase_clave: Before entry, operable communications with and availability of rescue services are verified.
razon: Verificar servicios de rescate antes de entrar.

frase_clave: When determined by an evaluation of worker noise exposure, a hearing conservation program has been implemented.
razon: Programa de conservacion auditiva cuando la evaluacion lo determine.

frase_clave: If a medical facility is not located near the workplace, at least one worker on each shift is adequately trained and qualified to render first aid.
razon: Instalacion medica cercana o persona capacitada en cada turno.

frase_clave: Dust collectors and powered exhausts are provided on grinders used in operations that produce large amounts of dust. ... Workers use appropriate PPE when grinding.
razon: Tiene razon el LECTOR A. El EPP al esmerilar si esta en el libro sin condicion (L1029), pero los colectores de polvo el libro los pide solo en esmeriladoras usadas en operaciones que producen grandes cantidades de polvo (L1025). El paso quita esa condicion y extiende los colectores a todo esmerilado. FIEL exige no alterar las condiciones del libro; aqui se amplia el alcance. No es CONTRARIO porque no fija otro umbral ni desaconseja nada: proveer colectores de mas va en la misma direccion y no trae datos nuevos.

frase_clave: Accurate records of workplace violence incidents are maintained and analyzed to determine what corrective actions are needed.
razon: Paso literal del libro.

frase_clave: Abrasive grinders have safety guards that cover the spindle, nut and flange projections; the guards are mounted to maintain proper alignment with the wheel
razon: Guardas sobre husillo, tuerca y bridas, alineadas.

frase_clave: If your workers are organized, set up communications, as you do in normal labor relations, to coordinate action on hazards in your business.
razon: El libro pide coordinar con los sindicatos la accion sobre los peligros; el paso lo parafrasea.

frase_clave: Appropriate atmospheric tests are performed to check for oxygen deficiency, flammable gases and vapors, and for potential toxic air contaminants in the confined space before entry.
razon: Pruebas antes de entrar y monitoreo durante el trabajo (L1329).

frase_clave: Workers use appropriate personal protective clothing and equipment when handling hazardous chemicals (e. g. , gloves, eye/face protection, respirators, etc. ).
razon: Mismo EPP del libro.

frase_clave: A written respiratory protection program has been established and implemented in accordance with the requirements of 29 CFR 1910.134(c).
razon: Programa escrito especifico del lugar segun la misma norma que cita el libro.

frase_clave: had hepatitis B vaccinations made available to them
razon: El libro pide poner a disposicion la vacuna contra hepatitis B a quien atiende emergencias medicas (y L905 formacion en vacunacion).

frase_clave: Pallets are inspected before being loaded or moved.
razon: Paso literal del libro.

frase_clave: The lockout procedure requires that stored energy (mechanical, hydraulic, air, etc. ) is released or blocked before equipment is locked out for service and maintenance.
razon: El libro exige liberar o bloquear la energia almacenada antes del servicio y mantenimiento; el paso lo dice igual.

frase_clave: Authorized workers have been trained on the lockout/tagout procedure, and are provided with personal safety locks or other approved lockout devices.
razon: El libro pide que los trabajadores autorizados esten capacitados y tengan candados personales, con candados o etiquetas que identifiquen a quien trabaja. El paso lo concreta en segunda persona para quien hace el trabajo; no contradice (el libro pone la provision a cargo del empleador, que en un pequeno negocio suele ser el mismo lector).

frase_clave: Are any of these job-related risk factors for heat exposure present in your workplace?
razon: Evaluar factores de riesgo de calor.

frase_clave: Employers can also read OSHA's standard interpretations, which are letters or memos written in response to questions from the public
razon: Revisar cartas de interpretacion oficiales.

frase_clave: Hazards that require the use of PPE (e. g. , head, eye, face, hand, or foot protection) have been identified.
razon: Paso literal del libro.

frase_clave: For more information, and to find contact information for your State Plan, see OSHA's State Plans webpage.
razon: Consultar la pagina de Planes Estatales, como el libro.

frase_clave: healthcare and social assistance, correctional settings, late-night retail, or taxi and for hire services/public transportation
razon: Industrias de alto riesgo que nombra el libro.

frase_clave: These are not OSHA standards, but they are developed by organizations through an open and balanced process to reflect current expertise and industry best practices.
razon: Tiene razon el LECTOR B. El libro describe los estandares de consenso voluntario (ANSI, NFPA) como algo que no es norma OSHA pero refleja buenas practicas de la industria; no manda revisarlos. El paso concreta esa descripcion en la accion 'revisar como buenas practicas complementarias', en la misma direccion y sin dato nuevo. 'Complementarias' recoge fielmente el 'not OSHA standards'. Es concrecion, no parafrasis literal.

frase_clave: you may be subject to different or additional requirements, and different or additional cooperative programs may be available to you
razon: Si tu plan estatal pone requisitos distintos o adicionales, ajustar el cumplimiento es la consecuencia directa; sin datos nuevos.

frase_clave: Contact NIOSH: 1-800-CDC-INFO or TTY 1-888232-6348, cdcinfo@cdc. gov.
razon: El libro ofrece el contacto directo de NIOSH.

frase_clave: Dockboards are capable of supporting the maximum intended load.
razon: Paso literal del libro.

frase_clave: permit-required confined spaces have been identified. Danger signs are posted
razon: Identificar y senalizar espacios confinados con permiso.

frase_clave: employers request a consultation visit from their local Consultation program
razon: Pedir visita al programa de consulta local.

frase_clave: analyze the possible hazards in terms of your workplace, your equipment, your materials, and your workers
razon: Paso literal del libro.

frase_clave: Machinery or equipment is locked out at the main power source; not at a push button, selector switch, or other control circuit type device.
razon: El libro pide bloquear en la fuente principal y no en dispositivos de control, e identificar al trabajador mediante el candado o la etiqueta; el paso lo parafrasea.

frase_clave: A lockout/tagout procedure has been developed in writing, and is reviewed at least annually.
razon: Procedimiento escrito revisado cada ano, literal.

frase_clave: All workers receive training on the workplace violence prevention program, (including de-escalation techniques), what to do in an emergency
razon: Capacitar a todos en desescalada y emergencias.

frase_clave: A buddy system is in place so workers observe each other for signs of heat-related illness.
razon: Paso literal del libro.

frase_clave: Work rests are used and kept adjusted to within 1/8 inch (0. 3175 centimeter) of the wheel. The adjustable tongue ... within 1/4 inch
razon: Ajustar descansos y lengueta a las distancias que fija el libro; el paso no cambia valores.

frase_clave: Standard operating procedures for cleaning up chemical spills are established and are being followed.
razon: Paso literal del libro.

frase_clave: A written permit-required confined space program has been implemented.
razon: Traduccion directa.

frase_clave: PIT operator performance is evaluated at least once every three years
razon: Misma frecuencia del libro.

frase_clave: Emergency phone numbers are posted.
razon: Paso literal del libro (tambien L237).

frase_clave: Unauthorized workers are not permitted to ride on PITs.
razon: Paso literal del libro.

frase_clave: Implement a flexible sick leave policy that allows and encourages workers to stay home while sick.
razon: Licencia flexible, registro de enfermedades infecciosas laborales (L931) y reporte de casos graves (L933), sin cifras nuevas.

frase_clave: For more information, and to find contact information for your State Plan, see OSHA's State Plans webpage.
razon: El libro remite a buscar el contacto de tu Plan Estatal para mas informacion; contactarlo ante dudas concreta eso sin datos nuevos.

frase_clave: A trained and equipped attendant is positioned outside the confined space ... Operable communications between the entrant(s) and the attendant is maintained
razon: Vigilante capacitado fuera con comunicacion mantenida.

frase_clave: Wet surfaces are covered with non-slip materials
razon: Traduccion literal.

frase_clave: Many workers' compensation carriers ... conduct periodic inspections and visits to evaluate safety and health hazards. ... Contact your carrier to see what it has to offer.
razon: Contactar a la aseguradora por sus servicios de inspeccion.

frase_clave: All OSHA publications are free at www. osha. gov/publications.
razon: Paso literal del libro.

frase_clave: FACE investigation reports and related NIOSH worker safety and health documents can be accessed at the NIOSH FACE webpage.
razon: Consultar reportes FACE, como indica el libro.

frase_clave: Workers are trained at least annually in the proper use of respirators, including putting on and removing them, any limitations on their use, and their maintenance.
razon: Capacitacion anual en uso, limitaciones y mantenimiento.

frase_clave: A program is in place for regular safety inspections of machinery and equipment.
razon: Paso literal del libro.

frase_clave: the appropriate and properly fitted PPE has been selected to provide suitable protection from these hazards
razon: El paso parafrasea seleccionar EPP adecuado y bien ajustado.

frase_clave: Grates or similar type covers over floor holes ... are designed to allow unimpeded foot traffic and rolling equipment.
razon: Rejillas que permiten transito de personas y equipos.

frase_clave: Before workers first use, or are fit-tested for, a respirator, they receive a medical evaluation
razon: Evaluacion medica antes del primer uso o prueba de ajuste.

frase_clave: Read the introduction to the subpart heading
razon: Leer la introduccion de cada subparte.

frase_clave: Hand trucks, pallet jacks, powered industrial trucks, and other equipment used for materials handling are maintained in safe operating condition.
razon: Mismos equipos y misma exigencia.

frase_clave: Fixed machines are anchored to prevent tipping or other movement.
razon: Paso literal del libro.

frase_clave: Occupational injuries or illnesses, except minor injuries requiring only first aid, are recorded on OSHA Form 300
razon: El libro pide registrar las lesiones y enfermedades registrables en el formulario correspondiente; el paso lo dice sin anadir.

frase_clave: Injury and illness records (OSHA 300, 300A, and 301) are kept at the worksite for at least five years. Worker medical and exposure records are retained for the time period required
razon: Conservar registros el tiempo minimo exigido; el paso no cambia el plazo.

frase_clave: Employers and safety and health professionals can sign-up for QuickTakes
razon: Inscribirse en QuickTakes para novedades.

frase_clave: Workers designated to wear tight-fitting respirators are fit-tested before their first use of a respirator and at least annually thereafter.
razon: Mismo momento y frecuencia del libro.

frase_clave: Energy source isolation is verified before work begins. Verification is accomplished by testing machinery, gauges, or other approved means.
razon: Verificar aislamiento con pruebas o medidores antes de trabajar.

frase_clave: Workers who only render first aid as a collateral duty are provided with appropriate PPE, such as gloves.
razon: EPP y formacion en patogenos de sangre para quien da primeros auxilios.

frase_clave: Red is used to identify the acetylene (and other fuel-gas) hose, green is used for the oxygen hose, and black is used for inert gas and air hoses.
razon: El libro da exactamente ese codigo de colores de mangueras.

razon: El libro pide bloquear o etiquetar los circuitos desenergizados antes de exponerse a ellos.

razon: Paráfrasis directa del libro.

frase_clave: Under SBREFA, OSHA must: - Produce Small Entity Compliance Guides for some agency rules; • Be responsive to small business inquiries about complying with the Agency's regulations
razon: Tenia razon el LECTOR A. El libro no le dice al lector que busque las guias; dice que OSHA esta obligada a producirlas (para algunas normas) y que la ley ayuda a los pequenos negocios a entender y cumplir. Pasar esa obligacion de OSHA a una accion del lector, consultar las guias cuando tenga dudas sobre una norma, concreta el recurso en la misma direccion y sin datos nuevos. No es FIEL porque la accion del paso (buscar ante dudas) no esta escrita en el libro.

frase_clave: The number of exits from each floor or level, and the number of exits from the building itself, are appropriate for the occupant load.

frase_clave: This required us to match the clearances from air traffic control given during the approach, and see how this updated both the track and the crew's evolving understanding of how much time was left.
razon: Tenia razon el LECTOR B. El libro hace exactamente eso: cruzar las autorizaciones de control (el ejemplo que conserva el paso) con la evolucion del vuelo para entender la carga de trabajo (L1129: plot time available against tasks they knew they still had to complete). Ademas L1140 da el principio general: the monitored process evolves in parallel with human activities to manage that process, so one usually allows you to infer what was going on in the other. El paso es parafrasis sin anadir accion, objeto ni condicion.

libro: The Field Guide to Understandin - Dekker, Sidney

libro: The Field Guide to Understandin - Dekker, Sidney

razon: Tenia razon el LECTOR B. El libro no solo cuenta el ejemplo de la distancia radial (It was useless): pide los datos que la tripulacion conocia en cada momento (I asked how many track miles the crew knew they had to go), advierte que la trayectoria volada a posteriori no es la que la tripulacion creia volar, y lo eleva a regla en L1135 (Remember at all times what you are trying to do). Verificar que los datos reflejen lo que el operador sabia, y no una metrica retrospectiva, es parafrasis directa, no una generalizacion propia.

libro: The Field Guide to Understandin - Dekker, Sidney

libro: The Field Guide to Understandin - Dekker, Sidney

libro: The Field Guide to Understandin - Dekker, Sidney

libro: The Field Guide to Understandin - Dekker, Sidney

libro: The Field Guide to Understandin - Dekker, Sidney

libro: The Field Guide to Understandin - Dekker, Sidney
frase_clave: Practitioners are not all exposed to the same kind and level of accident risk. This makes it impossible to compare their accident rates and say that some, because of personal characteristics, are more accident-prone than others.
razon: Tenia razon el LECTOR A. El libro critica el metodo de porcentajes y explica que la exposicion (rutas, noche o dia, especialidad) hace imposible comparar tasas y atribuirlas a rasgos personales; invita a estudiar el contexto (L480). El paso convierte esa critica en un procedimiento propio (analizar la exposicion por tarea, ruta y turno y hacerlo antes de atribuir culpa), que va en la misma direccion y no trae datos nuevos, pero la secuencia de analisis previo no esta escrita asi en el libro, que es mas tajante. Por eso es OPERATIVO y no FIEL; no es CONTRARIO porque no propone culpar.

frase_clave: Managers and workers have been trained on relevant child labor laws.
razon: Tenia razon el LECTOR A. El libro pone como punto de control que gerentes y trabajadores esten formados en las leyes de trabajo infantil aplicables. El paso lo adapta al dueno de un negocio pequeno: el aprende y el mismo lo explica a quien le ayuda. Cambia el sujeto y fija quien forma, algo que el libro no dice, pero es una concrecion en la misma direccion sin dato nuevo (no es una norma ni una cifra), asi que es OPERATIVO y no FIEL.

El libro muestra a dos partes (la aerolinea y la autoridad de aviacion civil) construyendo causas distintas para el mismo accidente, y lo resume en la Tabla 3.1 (Two different constructions of causes for the same accident) y en L1901. El paso la generaliza a las capacitaciones formales de seguridad laboral de cada mercado y conserva el cuando sea posible. Quitar la formacion especifica y ampliar el objeto a otras jurisdicciones es una concrecion en la misma direccion sin datos nuevos, no una parafrasis literal.

libro: The Field Guide to Understandin - Dekker, Sidney

libro: The Field Guide to Understandin - Dekker, Sidney

libro: The Field Guide to Understandin - Dekker, Sidney
frase_clave: You want to peg your investments in safety to the level of safety the particular activity has already attained. That way, it will not be either unattainable or irrelevant. Telling people in an ultra-safe activity that they need more rules and better compliance, for example, is not going to make things any safer.
razon: Tenia razon el LECTOR B. El libro cubre los dos sentidos del paso: las medidas de un nivel superior serian inalcanzables para una actividad riesgosa (unattainable; tambien L3762: hard fixes may be tried in unsafe systems as well, but they could well be resisted), y las de un nivel inferior serian irrelevantes en una actividad ultra segura (el ejemplo de mas reglas). Evitar copiar recetas de un nivel a otro, y viceversa, es parafrasis sin anadidos.

libro: The Field Guide to Understandin - Dekker, Sidney
frase_clave: Reprimanding people involved in the incident typically stops learning from that incident. Your organization cannot learn and punish at the same time.
razon: Tenia razon el LECTOR B. El libro dice que reprender a los involucrados detiene el aprendizaje del incidente y que no se puede aprender y castigar a la vez. El paso lo dice en positivo: no culpar a los involucrados para conservar lo que el incidente ensena. Entre sus componentes nombra los primeros auxilios psicologicos, y los situa tras un incidente que hirio o mato a alguien, que el paso resume como incidentes graves.
